items.coder_A: Official title names Adult Glioblastoma, but this registration's conditions, arm and inclusion criteria are recurrent medulloblastoma only.
items.reason: Although the official title names 'Adult Glioblastoma (GBM)', conditions are 'Recurrent Medulloblastoma', the only arm is 'recurrent/progressive Medulloblastoma (rMB)' and inclusion requires 'recurrent/progressive MB'; glioblastoma is not eligible in this registration.

items.coder_B: Official title names adult glioblastoma, but conditions, arm and eligibility enrol only recurrent medulloblastoma; coded not_glioblastoma.
items.reason: Same reasoning: naming in the title does not make GBM eligible when inclusion admits only medulloblastoma. Outcome-neutral anyway: the only intervention is an RNA-LP vaccine (excluded type).

note: Fails S5 and S6 (mRNA cancer vaccine). stdAges include CHILD (mixed_age).
